params.body:
## What

The SEO title field on hoet.be now asks to leave "Hoet" out on **every** page, the home page included, and shows what the site makes of it:

- **Description:** "Kort, belangrijkste woord vooraan, zonder "Hoet": op hoet.be zet de site het merk er zelf bij. "Contact" wordt "Contact - Hoet", en op de startpagina wordt "3D-geprinte titanium brillen" "Hoet - 3D-geprinte titanium brillen"."
- **Home page:** a title with the brand in it gets a warning: 'laat "Hoet" weg, op de startpagina komt "Hoet -" er vanzelf voor.' Until now the home page was exempt, so a typed "3D-geprinte titanium brillen-Hoet" showed no hint, although the site removes it anyway (hoet-eyewear #89).

The length warning on the home page counts the brand the site adds, like every other page.

## Checked

- 96 tests pass (`vitest`, without the token-bound `config.test.ts`). `tsc`, `sanity schema validate` (0 errors, 0 warnings) and lint pass.

## After merge

`npm run deploy` for the Studio.
params.title: Ask to leave the brand out of the home page title too
